findings.text: Defect B's reproduced door is not fixed. The three nova-49 refusals were reached on LANE-CHANGE attempts (r-...msc-figure-cohort-cite-or-retire attempt.json kind=lane-change, r-...ecq-... experiment likewise; r-...mcs-alive-graph-count-series lane-change-5-final.txt refuses citing deadline 2026-10-02T18:03:23Z, the first attempt's clock from its original prompt). change_lane composes its prompt with _lane_prompt and writes it at dispatch.py:10568 to lane-change-<n>-prompt.txt WITHOUT calling _restate_time_fence, so the lane-change prompt carries either the bare advice (continued) or the original full prompt with the original fence (fresh) — exactly 'the deadline it was handed at first dispatch'. The reviewed change only repairs the sibling door resumption._resume (resumption.py:781). The brief directed that an out-of-scope cause be recorded with its file:line and the change it needs; the manifest records neither this door nor nova-49's records, so the done-when clause 'The manifest names the cause of nova-49's three refusals, citing the records' is unmet. The change it needs: in change_lane, wrap prompt in _restate_time_fence(prompt, record, attempt_started_at=lane_change['changed_at']) before writing lane-change-<n>-prompt.txt, as resume_plan does at dispatch.py:10288.

The refusal marker is not round-scoped. REPAIR_ADVICE_SCOPE_LINE ('Write scope for this round: ') is identical in every round's advice, so _reviewed_run_refused_the_round cannot distinguish a manifest that refused THIS round's advice from one that refused an earlier round's. The guard is narrowed by same_round and prior>=1, so a same-round retry is only suppressed when the review's round id already matches, but a manifest quoting any round's scope line plus a terminal status reads as a refusal. Low risk given the run-level manifest is overwritten each turn; a round-id token in the composed advice would remove the ambiguity.

The fix commit folds a whole-file ruff format sweep into recovery.py (timezone.utc->UTC at 6651/7815, the typing import reordering at the 12-18 block, and unrelated line rewrapping at 3537/5267/5319/5483/8651/8927/8983/9422). The repo rule holds that a broad relint is its own commit; within a staged file this is permitted, but it obscures the change a reviewer must read and spans lines the node did not otherwise touch.
